content.short: GoBreeds is presented as Goblin Tribes Collection and future Free-To-Play | Play-To-Earn game.
content.description:
GoBreedsNFT is unique in the NFT space. Our project aims to achieve important milestones such as a collection of NFTs representing the blockchain, and inspired by the first NFT Goblin designs on the Cardano network.

This collection will have 750 NFTs in total, divided into 3 sets of 250 NFTs per set. Each set will be a new part of the collection until all 3 sets are completed, and each set will be made up of 4 tribes. There are a lot of variables, which make each GobreedsNFT even more unique and have different rarity percentages. In each tribe there are unique goblins with an assigned rank, we can find soldiers, looters, commanders, shamans, standard bearers, tribal chiefs and beasts.

In addition, each goblin will have unique clothing, accessories, tattoos and more! ALL GOBLINS HAVE DIFFERENT FEATURES In more advanced stages, the following will be created 3d figures of the collection, and a comic book will have two volumes about stories from the GoBreedsNFT world.
